title: The Queen of Nothing
author: Holly Black
summary: Jude is exiled in the mortal world, cut off from Faerie and Cardan. When her twin sister begs for help, she is dragged back into the court and a fight over the crown.
readIf: you have followed The Folk of the Air and want to see how Jude and Cardan's story ends.
skipIf: you have not read the earlier books, since this finale builds on them.
